summary: Backend: all 23 pytest cases pass (reels enrichment, auth incl. banned 403, like toggle, comments, reel/comment report+moderation, seller trust metrics, order flow for perishable & non-perishable, order rejections, admin login/metrics/settings/moderation/users). Frontend: desktop layout renders correctly (left sidebar, phone-frame reels feed, right sidebar with admin button); admin login + all 5 tabs (metrics/gateway/commission/moderation/users) load without errors after fix; 3-step checkout modal completes end-to-end for a non-perishable order (bKash + TrxID) with success toast + modal close. Fixed a critical runtime bug: UsersTab useEffect returned a Promise causing 'destroy is not a function' React runtime error overlay (visible to real users) and intermittent crashes on admin screens.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="nav-*-btn" renders twice in DOM (strict-mode locator collision). Likely BottomNav mounted in both mobile and desktop trees; one is hidden via CSS but still in DOM.

Buttons work functionally (JS click + real-user click succeed, success toasts appear) but Playwright reports them 'not visible' and getBoundingClientRect() returns 0x0 for the SVG-icon children. Does NOT affect actual users, only automated tests. Likely the lucide icon size classes not computed early or button has no intrinsic size until icon paints.

action_items: Review BottomNav duplication: ensure only one instance is rendered at a time (conditional on md breakpoint via JS) or make test IDs unique per layout, otherwise Playwright/strict selectors will keep breaking.
Optional: give action buttons explicit size (e.g. w-12 h-12) so e2e tests can reliably click them.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx had useEffect(load, []) where load() returned a Promise (apiGet(...).then(...)); React treats the return as a cleanup function and throws 'destroy is not a function' at unmount. Fixed by wrapping in useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). Similar anti-pattern to watch for in future files.

Frontend has a non-blocking Playwright-visibility quirk on reel action buttons — use JS click (page.evaluate) as fallback when needed. Admin UsersTab useEffect-returning-Promise bug has been patched.
rca of the issue: Runtime error 'destroy is not a function' (visible as full-screen Emergent runtime error overlay) was caused by `const load = () => apiGet('/admin/users').then(setUsers); useEffect(load, []);` in AdminDashboard.jsx UsersTab. React's useEffect expects the effect fn to return either undefined or a cleanup fn; `load` returned a Promise. On unmount React tried to call `.destroy()` on the Promise and threw. Mitigation: wrapped load() in a block-body effect: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])`. Same fix applied to Moderation component for consistency.
